title: Selling Sunset
synopsis: The elite real estate brokers at The Oppenheim Group sell the luxurious life to their high-end clients in L.A., while the drama spills into both their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: 1. Game Changer
episodes.synopsis: Flying high, Chrishell reveals her latest love — Jason. In LA, the agents get real about the relationship while Christine readies her return.

episodes.title: 2. Nothing Remains The Same
episodes.synopsis: Hearts flip as Heather weds Tarek. Jason and Mary grapple with being ghosted. Chrishell reveals her latest love — Jason. In LA, the agents face life-changing decisions.
